user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of landing pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.opt_out: Data is not used to train models; only visits submitted ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling to train generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated requests from ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated action; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content for AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Generative AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses web content in response to user questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content during user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to enhance search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes and indexes content for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information to build Google's search indexes and perform analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using the Googlebot user-agent token.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Search and image-related features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-Image or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video-related content for Google Search and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-Video or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls news content for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Googlebot-News or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls product pages for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping and the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using the Storebot-Google user-agent token.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Executes crawls for Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible content for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Generic crawler used across various Google product teams without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using the GoogleOther user-agent token.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development fetching of publicly accessible images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther tokens.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Internal research and development fetching of publicly accessible videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther tokens.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs site owner-requested crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawling requests; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot tokens.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of site content for training and grounding Gemini models.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models for Gemini Apps, Vertex AI, and grounding features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using the Google-Extended user-agent token.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web information automatically for Perplexity services.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index web information in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers Apple search technology and crawls data for generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and training generative foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Determines whether crawled data is used to train generative AI models; does not crawl.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered Apple Podcasts content.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared across Meta's family of apps.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improves Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Navigates the web to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for advertising and business-related improvements.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by direct indexing.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for foundation AI model training and direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links fetched at user request to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages for Bing search indexing and Copilot answers.
user_agents.scope: Standard web crawl across internet sites.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot via robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves real-time web page snapshots and previews for Microsoft services.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered or automated previews in Copilot and Bing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow MicrosoftPreview via robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for Amazon product improvement and AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Web content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer user queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web fetch on user behalf; not for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Initiated by users, so it may not follow all robots.txt directives.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web pages to build open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web sampled and archived by Common Crawl.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or use opt-out registry.
